name: Campfire
description: People camp around the fire and trade what they know, so knowledge spreads. Every new fire costs a little more wood.

name: Fish trap
description: Woven traps in the shallows. Fish run best in spring and summer, and the river only holds so many.

name: Woodcutters' camp
description: Stone axes and a drag path to the forest. Brings in wood faster.

name: Hunting camp
description: Spear hunters bring in game. Autumn is the best season, and summer the worst.

name: Shelter
description: Hide-and-pole huts. Room for 6 more people, and a little more calm.

name: Drying rack
description: Fish and meat dried in smoke keep through the winter, so less goes to waste.

name: Healer's hut
description: Herbs, set bones, and women attended in childbirth. Fewer people die and fewer pregnancies are lost.

name: Story circle
description: A ring of stones where elders tell the old stories. People feel they belong, and what is learned is remembered.

name: Dugout canoe
description: A hollowed log reaches deep water. Big catches in spring and summer.

name: Storage pit
description: Lined pits and clay pots keep nuts, grain and dried fish from spoiling, and add to what you can store.
